product.what: An agency of role agents for the products of the owner. The roles read a product, meet and rank what to do next. The owner approves each change. A native Linux app, a core daemon, a command line client and a Claude Code plugin.
product.audience: The owner first, the only developer. Devs who see AgentSI on X are a second audience with no objective.

objectives.text: The app is the daily workplace. ROADMAP.md sections: UI polish, File management and day-to-day tasks, More git, and The switch-over.
objectives.signal: 20 days or more each month with an owner message at the front desk of any product (desk_items, kind owner). The outside list in docs/product.md gets shorter at each review.

objectives.text: The roles know the product and are correct. ROADMAP.md sections: Context injection into agents, More audits, and the issue trackers and docs of Third-party integrations.
objectives.signal: 75% or more of the marks of the month are accepted (table priorities, column mark). The value 75% is a guess.

sources_of_truth.note: The sections that the objectives cover.
The map of the roadmap sections to the objectives.

out_of_scope: Platforms other than Linux, such as macOS and a mobile app.
A remote client. Claude Code remote control covers it.
Any action without the approval of the owner.

roles.pm: Ranks the sections of ROADMAP.md against o1 and o2 and writes the minutes.
roles.dev: Judges the cost and the risk of the work in crates/, plugin/ and the switch-over.
roles.qa: Checks that the roles are correct: the marks, the audits and the failed checks.
